title: Behind the scenes of Viceroy Seaglider first flight
body_markdown:
Go behind the scenes with the REGENT team that just made history as we watch the first flight of our Viceroy Seaglider prototype.


Months of engineering, testing, and problem-solving came down to this moment. We're so proud of the people who made this possible — from engineering to operations to manufacturing to business development, the entire crew has been working toward the same goal.


If you're excited about building the first new mode of transportation in nearly a century, join the crew today:[https://lnkd.in/dg8zaiP ‍](https://lnkd.in/dg8zaiP) Don’t see the right fit today? Join our Talent Community and stay connected as we grow:[https://lnkd.in/gmEAbuNS](https://lnkd.in/gmEAbuNS)
